blocks.text: Hydrogen bond dipole-dipole force ki ek khas qism hai. Yeh intermolecular forces mein sab se mazboot hai magar bond ki sab bari qismon, ionic, metallic aur covalent, se kamzor. Hydrogen bond do sharait poori hone par banta hai: hydrogen atom F, O ya N jaise bohat electronegative atom se jura ho, aur us electronegative atom par electrons ka lone pair ho. Bohat electronegative atom aur hydrogen ke darmiyan covalent bond bohat polarized hai, to hydrogen kaafi delta+ charge aur electronegative atom delta- charge rakhta hai; electronegative atom par lone pair juzvi musbat hydrogen ko F, O ya N se bond banane deta hai, hydrogen bond, jo nuqtedar lakeer se dikhaya jata hai aur jis ki mazbooti aam covalent bond ka taqreeban daswan hissa hai. Ek molecule ausatan kitne hydrogen bonds bana sakta hai yeh electronegative atom se bandhe hydrogen atoms ki tadaad aur F, O ya N par lone pairs ki tadaad par munhasir hai.

Pani ke molecule mein do hydrogen atoms aur oxygen par do lone pairs hain, to woh ausatan do hydrogen bonds banata hai; is liye pani ke molecules wasee taur par hydrogen bonded hain, jo pani ko us ki makhsoos khusoosiyat deta hai, jaise 100 degrees C ka ooncha boiling point, aur liquid mein molecules seh-jehti tarteeb mein hain, bonding do electronegative oxygen atoms ke darmiyan pul banati hui. Ammonia teen hydrogen atoms ke bawajood fi molecule sirf ek hydrogen bond banati hai, kyunke nitrogen par sirf ek lone pair hai; us ki hydrogen bonding pani se kahin kamzor aur boiling point kahin kam hai, -33 degrees C. HF mein fluorine par teen lone pairs hain, jo teen bonds ki ijazat dete, magar sirf ek hydrogen atom, to yeh bhi ek bond tak mehdood hai; phir bhi bond fluorine ki zyada electronegativity ki wajah se mazboot hai, aur us ka boiling point (19.9 degrees C) ammonia (-33.5 degrees C) se kahin zyada hai. Solid mein HF molecules hydrogen bonds se tehri-merhi (zig-zag) zanjeer mein jurte hain. HCl, HBr aur HI ke muqable mein HF ki ghair-mamooli kam tezabi taqat isi mazboot hydrogen bonding se mansoob hai, kyunke juzvi musbat hydrogen do bohat electronegative atoms ke darmiyan phansa hua hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyani pani ka molecule gulabi dashed hydrogen bonds se chaar padosi molecules se juda: us ke do H atoms do padosiyon ke O atoms se, aur us ke O ke do lone pairs doosre do molecules ke H atoms se. Key hydrogen bond aur covalent bond mein farq dikhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya CHF3 hydrogen bond bana sakta hai? Ethanol ke do molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bond dikhayein, aur CH3CH2CH3, CH3CH2OH aur CH3CH2Cl ko maujood forces ke saath barhte boiling point ki tarteeb mein rakhein.
blocks.explanation: CHF3 nahi bana sakta: us ki hydrogen carbon se bandhi hai, F, O ya N se nahi, to woh kaafi polarized nahi, agarche us ke fluorine atoms doosre molecules se hydrogen bonds qabool kar sakte hain. Ethanol mein ek O-H group ki hydrogen doosre molecule ki oxygen ke lone pair ki taraf khinchti hai, O-H ... O. Propane mein sirf London forces hain, chloroethane dipole-dipole forces jorta hai, aur ethanol hydrogen bonds, to boiling points propane < chloroethane < ethanol ki tarteeb mein barhte hain.

items: Hydrogen bond: H F, O ya N par, us atom par lone pair ke saath; sab se mazboot intermolecular force, covalent bond ka taqreeban daswan hissa, nuqtedar lakeer se dikhaya jata hai.
